assertions.assertion: Explains that UserOrNone forwards user token if available, no token if anonymous, without triggering a challenge
assertions.rationale: Says user token if logged in, otherwise none attached and request still forwarded; not explicit about no challenge but implied by forwarding.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT recommend RequiredTokenType.User (which would challenge anonymous users)
assertions.rationale: Does not recommend User; only lists it as requiring login.
